description:
Cross-client portfolio: per-workspace (per-client) KPIs plus rolled-up totals — the agency view. Groups store rollups by each store's current workspace over every workspace you can view analytics in. Requires an agency (Enterprise) account with Advanced Analytics; other accounts get a feature_unavailable error. Read-only.

[#65a008]

currency.description: Reporting currency (e.g. "USD"). Currencies are segmented, never summed.

end.description: End date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to default to today (UTC).

start.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Omit to default to 30 days before end.

workspace.description: Workspace uuid to scope to (agency accounts). Omit for the Default workspace.

name: analytics_portfolio
